from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
code = '''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = [[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    rects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or seen[r][c]:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)])
            seen[r][c] = True
            cells = []
            while q:
                y,x = q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and not seen[yy][xx] and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen[yy][xx]=True; q.append((yy,xx))
            ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            # Large, nearly solid components mark rectangular objects; stray
            # pixels are noise and are assigned by whether they fall in a box.
            if area >= 4 and len(cells)/area >= 0.65:
                rects.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,color))
    out = [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # Rectangles in this task do not overlap. Preserve their color and repair
    # any displaced/noise cells inside them.
    for r0,r1,c0,c1,color in rects:
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
